methods_en: Use three independent models and 64 held-out history patterns per model, totaling 192 examples with successful four-step rollouts. Select the attention layer and query read-position on training data, then freeze them for testing. Compare exact FCI, gradient norm, DFG along the actual cue-flip direction, three-point integrated DFG and batched future margin. Record counterfactual TV at each horizon.
results_en: Source Top-1: calibrated attention 58.3%, attention×future-gradient 58.3%, gradient norm 69.3%, DFG 79.2%, and 100% for three-point IDFG, batched future margin and exact FCI. Relevant-source TV was about 0.000054/0.000056 at H1/H2 and 0.998948/0.998897 at H3/H4. All 192 examples first exceeded TV=0.1 at H3.
interpretation_en: Measuring along an actual counterfactual connects local sensitivity to an operation that changes the future. Horizon profiles reveal constraints whose effects are still latent in the text. The 100% score describes source identification in this constructed task.
